# Inquiry-synthesis guidance

Treat an inquiry README as active synthesis, not product authority. Follow
[docs/RESEARCH_METHOD.md](../../docs/RESEARCH_METHOD.md),
[docs/EVIDENCE_STANDARD.md](../../docs/EVIDENCE_STANDARD.md), and
[docs/HORIZONS_AND_MATURITY.md](../../docs/HORIZONS_AND_MATURITY.md).

Preserve one horizon, honest maturity, confidence and uncertainty, concrete
review triggers, negative knowledge, serious alternatives, and traceable
downstream disposition. Separate evidence, inference, and recommendation.
Materially changed conclusions require explicit amendment or supersession;
never infer another repository's acceptance from implementation similarity.
